_desc: Threat Hunting — Suricata 원문 규칙. TLS SNI/HTTP 로 알려진 악성 패턴 alert·drop.
_usage: aws network-firewall create-rule-group --rule-group-name lab-nfw-suricata --type STATEFUL --capacity 200 --rule-group file://threat.json
_note: rules_string 은 Suricata 문법. sid 는 유일. drop=차단, alert=로깅만.

RulesSource.RulesString:
drop tls $HOME_NET any -> any any (tls.sni; content:"malware.example.com"; startswith; nocase; msg:"block malware SNI"; sid:1001; rev:1;)
drop http $HOME_NET any -> any any (http.host; content:"evil.test"; msg:"block evil host"; sid:1002; rev:1;)
alert tcp $HOME_NET any -> any 4444 (msg:"suspicious port 4444"; sid:1003; rev:1;)
pass tcp $HOME_NET any -> any 443 (msg:"allow https"; sid:1004; rev:1;)
